phases.title: The work was difficult enough.
phases.description: Engineering evidence is present, but fragmented: positions compete, records lose alignment, and comparisons require reconstruction.

phases.title: Friction was not a requirement.
phases.description: A deliberate intervention separates useful structure from unnecessary reconstruction. Values regain their reference and measurement traces become readable.

Different kinds of work are resolved: a spatial measurement, a comparison and a structured record. Their capabilities stay in one surface, which becomes the real ARTIFACTS homepage and opens into the applications.
